toegepas.voor: Skuilings het nie dieselfde vorm nie
toegepas.na: Skuilings het nie almal dieselfde vorm nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without 'almal' the sentence reads oddly, as if shelters lacked some single shared shape; 'nie almal' says plainly that they differ from one another.
toegepas.fout: 'Skuilings het nie dieselfde vorm nie' reads loosely, as if no two shelters share a shape.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'nie almal dieselfde vorm nie' is the natural Afrikaans way to say shelters differ, and it matches the lesson's own example of many nests sharing a cup shape.

toegepas.voor: Skuilings is ook nie ewe groot nie
toegepas.na: Skuilings is ook nie almal ewe groot nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Keeps this sentence parallel with the corrected shape sentence and makes the comparison between shelters explicit.
toegepas.fout: Same loose comparison as the shape sentence, two sentences later in the same paragraph.
toegepas.rede_keurder: With change 1 kept, 'nie almal ewe groot nie' keeps the two parallel sentences matching and the meaning is unchanged.

laat_vaar.voor: en hou 'n perdeby se nes stewig
laat_vaar.na: en maak 'n perdeby se nes stewig
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Hou ... stewig' is awkward for a material that hardens; 'maak ... stewig' is the natural collocation and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'hou 'n perdeby se nes stewig' (keeps it sturdy) is natural Afrikaans, and 'maak ... stewig' is a lateral move that shifts keeping into making.

na_skrywer.voor: een sterk buitekant om die ruimte binne
na_skrywer.na: een sterk buitekant om die ruimte binne-in
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A bare 'binne' after a noun copies English 'the space inside'; 'binne-in' is the natural Afrikaans adverb here.
na_skrywer.fout: 'om die ruimte binne' copies English 'the space inside' and leaves 'binne' hanging.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this block sentence mirrors the dopstruktuur definition, which only the writer may change, so applying it alone would split the pair; the writer should fix both together.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Sterk buitekant om die ruimte binne
na_skrywer.na: 'n Sterk buitekant om die ruimte binne-in
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The same fix as in the study block, so the definition and the block keep matching.
na_skrywer.fout: Same hanging 'om die ruimte binne' in the glossary definition.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: It rewords a [begrip] definition beyond a plain spelling or grammar fix, so it goes to the writer together with the matching study-block sentence.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: More natural word order: the object comes before the place adverb.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'maak dikwels daar hul huis' is already natural Afrikaans order; the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Both forms are correct, but the decided habitat definition in the glossary says 'lewe', so the body sentence should use the same verb.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'leef' and 'lewe' are equally natural and the body sentence paraphrases rather than quotes the definition, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Baie voëlneste is soos 'n diep koppie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Baie voëlneste lyk soos 'n diep koppie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'lyk soos' is the natural way to compare a shape; 'is soos' sounds wooden.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'is soos 'n diep koppie wat die eiers binnehou' compares both shape and function, and 'lyk soos' narrows it to appearance only.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die plek waar 'n dier veilig is
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A shelter is one of many places, as the study text itself says ('n Skuiling is 'n plek ...), so the indefinite article fits better than 'Die'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Die plek waar ...' is the normal definite form for a glossary definition and matches the decided habitat definition, so there is no fault and nothing to send to the writer.
